coverage_limits: All 48 original limitation IDs are mapped. All 26 old links appear exactly once across the three bindings.
The three alternative legal routes pleaded concerning Respondent No.2 remain within one focal transaction binding. They are not incorrectly represented as three proven transactions.
Respondents' denials and allegations of continued business are retained with the focal arrangement and are not transformed into findings.
The restored L109 parent clarifies that Rawat Mal is the antecedent of the heirs' tenancy account; it does not adjudicate the truth of their tenant status.
The witness's reference to legal heirs of Respondent No.1 and Respondent No.2 is not automatically joined with the named B1 actors merely through matching litigation-role numbers.
The witness's cross-examination dates in May and August 2024 do not date the alleged disposition.
The trade-license and GST exhibit is recorded only by title. Its actual contents were not independently supplied or inspected.
The allegation that Sampat Saini is the firm's proprietor does not establish that Sampat Saini and Divya Jyoti Electronics are interchangeable legal actors.
Unknown disposition dates affect the temporal test without deleting recorded allegations of event types.
Written consent is alleged absent by the petitioner, but the respondents' composite denial cannot be converted into affirmative proof that written consent existed.
The absence of a smaller premises delineation does not automatically defeat a whole-premises allegation.
C06 is a qualification to the parting-with-possession route only, and cannot automatically resolve subletting or assignment.
The supplied legal template does not establish burdens, standards of proof, or burden shifts; NOT_COVERED is not a categorical restriction on facts.
All material remains at the supplied retrospective pre-target status. No legal test label, complete statutory claim, eviction result, or target-stage decision is predicted.
